child_safety.assessment: Every 85 quick board payload, 352 recipe explanations, 252 concepts and 49 extension triples was inspected as existing game text. Household/school/nature/family/cultural/sport associations and food explanations contain no explicit sexual, abusive or graphic material. History triples refer to named wars and public historical figures without graphic detail. Existing public performers/sportspeople are unchanged; this issues no new living-person approval. World pairs remain dish ideas, with cooked fish/meat and preparation qualifiers where stated; they are not complete cooking instructions. External citations remain historical provenance; their current remote page contents and advertising were not re-fetched or newly certified.
